NOTE: Share, average share data fully diluted. On a primary basis, nine-month results were profit $0.26/shr vs loss $0.09/shr and average shares were 23.1 million vs 22.7 million.

Nine-month results include gains from discontinued operations of $4.3 million or $0.13/shr ($0.18 primary) vs $2.1 million or $0.07/shr ($0.09/primary). 1995 nine-month results include loss of $3.4 million or $0.11/shr ($0.15 primary) from extraordinary item to write off debt issuance costs.
1996 nine-month results include gain from accounting change of $1.6 million or $0.05/shr ($0.07/shr primary).
